card.name: The word oral after a drug name
card.fires_on: The word "oral" (or "Oral") placed right after a drug name, usually a salt such as hydrochloride or phosphate, and just before "solution". It appears in drug-interaction and warning passages.

modes.description: "oral" follows a drug name ending in hydrochloride, phosphate or sulfate, and comes before "solution".
